Dundee vs Hearts; Scottish Premiership
Dundee vs Hearts. Scottish Premiership.
The Scot Foam Stadium at Dens Park.
Dundee 0-8 Hearts: Ruthless Jambos return to winning ways with Scottish Premiership demolition at Dens Park
Report as Hearts put eight past Dundee at Dens Park; the Jambos scored four goals in each half; the Dark Blues have Owen Bevan sent off; it was their biggest top-flight victory since 1957; it moves them to within a point of third-place Falkirk
Saturday 21 November 2026 20:33, UK
Hearts returned to winning ways in spectacular style as they destroyed 10-man Dundee 8-0 at Dens.
The Jam Tarts went into the game on the back of a run of three straight defeats but they ran riot against the Dark Blues, netting four in the first half thanks to Sabah Kerjota, a Pierre Landry Kabore double and an own goal by Ryan Finnigan.
Dundee were reduced to 10 men after the break with Owen Bevan shown a straight red card before Claudio Braga, Sabri Guendouz, Kerjota with his second and Stuart Findlay blew Dundee away with four more goals.

Hearts made the most of their first big chance in the 23rd minute. A long kick-out by Jam Tarts keeper Beau Reus caused havoc, with Dundee defender Bevan trying to clear under pressure from Braga but instead he sent the ball directly to Kerjota, who chested down before clinically firing past Owen Goodman.
And just two minutes later, the travelling fans were celebrating once more. Goodman fumbled a cross with the defence again all at sea before the ball broke to Kabore on the ground and he stabbed home.
Dundee then came close to pulling one back when Westley headed against the bar from a Reilly free-kick.
That was only a temporary respite with Hearts making it three in the 32nd minute when McPake found space down the left and squared to Kabore who gleefully fired past Goodman.
However, the keeper could not prevent Hearts from making it 4-0 in the 40th minute when McPake cut in from the left and hit a shot that took a deflection off Finnigan and flew past Goodman.
The Jambos thought they had made it 5-0 in the 53rd minute when Braga embarked on a great run through the heart of the Dundee defence before firing past Goodman but the goal was ruled out after a VAR check for handball.
Dundee's dismal night then became even worse when Bevan wiped out Braga, with referee Steven McLean brandishing a straight red card.
In the 73rd minute Jordi Altena squared to Braga who rifled home and this time he would not be denied by VAR.
Six minutes later, Goodman was picking the ball out of the back of his net again when sub Guendouz cut in from the left and smashed a shot past the keeper.
Hearts made it 7-0 in the 81st minute with Kerjota netting his second with a sweet first-time finish before Findlay well and truly put the icing on the cake eight minutes later, heading past Goodman.
digest_he:
הארטס רשמה את ניצחון הליגה הבכירה הגדול ביותר שלה מאז שנת 1957, לאחר שהביסה בחוץ 8-0 את דנדי. המשחק התנהל בשליטה מלאה של האורחים, כאשר סבאח קריג'וטה כבש צמד, פייר לאנדרי קאבורה הוסיף צמד משלו, ושער עצמי של ראיין פיניגן חתם את המחצית הראשונה ביתרון ארבעה שערים.

במחצית השנייה המצב של המקומיים החמיר לאחר שדנדי נותרה בעשרה שחקנים בעקבות כרטיס אדום ישיר שנשלף לעבר אוון בוואן. קלאודיו בראגה, סברי גוונדוז, שער נוסף של קריג'וטה ונגיחה של סטיוארט פינדלי סגרו עניין והשלימו את התוצאה המוחצת.
